name: ChartFormat
description: Provides access to the OfficeArt formatting for chart elements.
remarks: Using a property or method that does not apply to the type of object the ChartFormat object is attached to will result in a run-time error.

properties.name: Fill
properties.description: Returns a FillFormat object for the parent chart element that contains fill formatting properties for the chart element. Read-only.

properties.name: Glow
properties.description: Returns the glow formatting properties for the chart element. Read-only GlowFormat.

properties.name: Line
properties.description: Returns the line formatting properties for the specified chart element. Read-only LineFormat.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent for the specified object. Read-only Object.

properties.name: PictureFormat
properties.description: Returns a PictureFormat object for a specified chart that contains pictures. Read-only.

properties.name: Shadow
properties.description: Returns shadow formatting properties for the chart element. Read-only ShadowFormat.

properties.name: SoftEdge
properties.description: Returns the soft edge formatting for a shape. Read-only SoftEdgeFormat.

properties.name: TextFrame2
properties.description: Returns the text formatting for the specified chart element. Read-only TextFrame2.

properties.name: ThreeD
properties.description: Returns the 3D-effect formatting properties for the specified chart. Read-only ThreeDFormat.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft PowerPoint application. When used with an object qualifier, returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object (you can use this property with an Automation object to return the application of that object). Read-only.

properties.name: Adjustments
properties.description: Returns an Adjustments object that contains a collection of adjustment values for the specified Chart Format object.

properties.name: AutoShapeType
properties.description: Returns or sets the auto shape type of the specified object. Read/write MSOAutoShapeType.
